strategy.loadFailed: Could not load the negotiation strategies.

assignment.intro: These rows decide which strategy a quote gets: a pinned customer, then a matching rule, then a weighted split are tried in that order, before the sales channel's default strategy applies.
assignment.truncated: This shop has {total} assignment rows; only the first {shown} are shown here. The agent still applies every row when it resolves a quote — the rest just cannot be seen or edited from this page.
assignment.pinsIntro: A pin always wins: the named customer gets this strategy before any rule or split is tried.
assignment.customerIsCompany: On a B2B shop this is the company account: the pin covers every employee and organization unit under it, not a single person.
assignment.incompletePin: Choose a customer and a strategy before this row can be saved.
assignment.incompleteRule: Choose a rule and a strategy before this row can be saved.
assignment.incompleteSplit: Choose a strategy and enter a weight above zero before this row can be saved.
assignment.duplicatePinGlobal: {customer} is already pinned for every sales channel.
assignment.duplicatePinChannel: {customer} is already pinned for this sales channel.
assignment.notSaved: This change could not be confirmed as saved. Please check the row and try again.
assignment.rulesIntro: The highest-priority rule that matches the quote wins, if no customer is pinned. Priority comes from the rule itself.
assignment.rulesEmpty: No rule is bound to a strategy yet.
assignment.flowConditionsNote: Conditions built only for orders or flows are never true for a quote: a rule made only from them will never match, and nothing will report that it didn't.
assignment.duplicateRuleGlobal: {rule} is already bound to every sales channel.
assignment.duplicateRuleChannel: {rule} is already bound to this sales channel.
assignment.splitIntro: If no pin and no rule matched, a customer falls into one of these arms, chosen by weight — this is what makes A/B testing a negotiation strategy possible.
assignment.splitEmpty: No split arms yet, so no quote is placed by weight.
assignment.weightsAreRelative: Weights are relative, not percentages: they don't need to add up to 100. Typing 1 and 4 gives the first arm 20% and the second 80%. The share shown is only against the other arms in the same sales channel.
assignment.stickyPerCustomer: A customer keeps the same arm across every quote they send, so one buyer never meets two different negotiating postures. Changing a weight reshuffles which customers land in which arm, so weigh that before tuning an experiment that is already running.
assignment.splitScopeNote: Global arms (no sales channel chosen) only apply to a sales channel that has no split arms of its own — once a channel has any arm here, its customers are placed only among that channel's own arms.

review.title: Draft awaiting your review
review.intro: Draft Mode is on: the agent prepared this but sent nothing. Check it, change what you like, then send it or reject it.
review.introClarification: The agent wants to ask the buyer a question. Nothing was sent.
review.introAcknowledgement: The agent wants to acknowledge the buyer's message. Nothing was sent.
review.discountAmount: Quote discount: {amount}, a fixed amount that lands the gross total on the round figure of {total}.
review.discountSwitch: A percentage replaces the fixed amount, so the gross total will no longer land on a round figure.
review.overCap: Above your configured maximum of {cap}. The agent could not have offered this — you can.
review.checkReplyAfterEdit: You changed the draft. Check that the reply still matches the prices and date, or update the preview for suggested wording.
review.rejected: Draft rejected. Handle the quote in SwagCommercial.
review.readOnly: You can see this draft but not send or reject it. Ask for the “Quote agent: review drafts” permission.

error.stale: The buyer wrote again or the quote changed since this draft. Reject it — the agent drafts again on the buyer's next message.
error.gone: The prepared prices for this draft no longer exist. Reject it and handle the quote in SwagCommercial.
error.published: A merchant reply may already be visible to the buyer. Check the quote in SwagCommercial before changing this review.
error.not_pending: This draft was already handled or replaced.
error.busy: The agent is working on this quote right now. Try again in a few seconds.
error.unavailable: Quotes cannot be edited because SwagCommercial is not licensed.
error.generic: That did not work. Try again.
error.send_failed: The draft could not be sent. Check the quote in SwagCommercial before trying again: the reply may already be visible to the buyer.

invalid.malformed: The review could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
invalid.not_an_admin_user: Only a signed-in administration user can send a draft.
invalid.empty_reply: The reply to the buyer is empty. Write a reply before sending.
invalid.discount_out_of_range: The discount must be between 0 and 100 percent.
invalid.negative_price: A unit price cannot be negative.
invalid.date_format: Enter the validity date as a calendar day.
invalid.date_in_past: The validity date is in the past. Pick today or a later day.
invalid.price_increase: These prices would raise the total above what the quote shows now. Lower them, or reject the draft and handle the quote in SwagCommercial.
invalid.no_prices: This draft changes no prices, so there are none to edit.
invalid.unknown_line: One of the edited lines is no longer on this quote. Reload the page.
invalid.comment_too_long: The comment is longer than 2,000 characters.
invalid.empty_feedback: Pick at least one reason or write a comment.

status.superseded: Draft replaced by a newer one

escalationWhy.anUnstatedAmount: an amount it could not read as a percentage
escalationWhy.discount_limit_exceeded: The customer asked for {asked}, which is more than your {cap} maximum discount. Granting more than the cap is a decision only a person can make.
escalationWhy.quote_value_limit_exceeded: This quote is worth {value}, above the maximum quote value you set for negotiation. Large quotes are handed over whatever the discount asked for.
escalationWhy.currency_mismatch: No maximum quote value is configured for {currency}, so the agent cannot tell whether this quote is inside your ceiling. Set one for that currency to let it negotiate.
escalationWhy.needs_human_review: A person needs to complete this quote directly; no more specific category applies. If the customer's own request was recorded, it is shown alongside this reason.
escalationWhy.not_configured: The agent is switched on but its configuration is incomplete or invalid, so it answered nothing rather than guess. The technical details below name the fields.
escalationWhy.model_unavailable: The model could not be reached or answered with something unusable. Nothing was written to the quote.
escalationWhy.model_declined: The agent reviewed this ask and chose to hand it to a person instead of making an offer. Nothing was written to the quote.
escalationWhy.proposal_rejected: The model proposed terms outside the authority your policies allow, so the policy layer refused them. The quote was left untouched.
escalationWhy.verification_failed: The quote was changed, but re-reading it did not match what had been authorised, so it needs a person to confirm before the customer is told anything.
escalationWhy.structural_change_requested: The customer asked to change what is being sold — quantity, a removed line, or an added product — rather than its price. The agent only negotiates price, so a person needs to make this change.
escalationWhy.non_price_term_requested: The customer asked for a delivery or payment term. The agent can only negotiate price, and nothing here can grant or write a non-price term, so a person needs to answer that part.
escalationWhy.unplaceable_ask: The agent could not tell which line, or what, the customer's comment was asking about, and a follow-up question did not resolve it. A person needs to read the conversation directly.
escalationWhy.no_further_concession: The customer asked for a better price, but this pass could not lower the quote: your maximum discount or minimum margin is already reached, or the agent found nothing it could offer. A person decides whether to go further.

write.updateLineItems: Set new unit prices on the requested lines
write.updateQuote: Applied the discount and a new validity date

note.attemptRetried: An earlier attempt on this quote crashed before it finished ({count} so far). This pass started over.
note.nothingToDo: There was nothing for the agent to answer: either no new customer message it could read and no open price target on any line, or the quote is already with your team after an escalation. The quote was left untouched.
note.handedOver: Someone from your team had already answered this quote more recently than the customer wrote, so the agent left it alone. It will pick the conversation up again if the customer replies.
note.acknowledged: The customer's message held no request the agent could act on, so it replied by restating the quote as it stands and sent it back for acceptance. Nothing on the quote changed.
note.notAuthorized: The agent proposed terms your policies do not allow, so nothing was authorised and the quote was left untouched.
note.notVerified: The quote was changed, but re-reading it afterwards did not match what had been authorised.
note.needsAttention: This pass reported success but did not finish cleanly. Check the quote before relying on it.

history.offersAccepted: Accepted quotes with an authorized proposal
